title: Parametric representation of a finite-mass IMRep by integer-weighted bi-Lipschitz pieces (supplied steps 2–3 and (AF))
statement: Assume (B1), (GB) and (IMC). (B1) is the exact frozen type of the accepted Submission.dpf_rectifiable_bilipschitz_pieces: every Borel countably n-rectifiable M ⊆ ℝ^P has Lipschitz G_i : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P, Borel A_i ⊆ ℝⁿ and m_i > 0 (i ∈ ℕ) with m_i|a − a'| ≤ |G_i(a) − G_i(a')| on A_i, G_i differentiable with injective derivative at every point of A_i, G_i(A_i) Borel ⊆ M, the G_i(A_i) pairwise disjoint and Hⁿ(M ∖ ⋃_i G_i(A_i)) = 0. (GB) is the exact frozen type of the accepted Submission.covectorEuclideanNorm_gram_bounds: for all P, n, (i) |α(v)| ≤ |α|·√det(⟨v_a, v_b⟩)_{a,b} for every n-covector α and v : Fin n → ℝ^P, and (ii) for orthonormal τ there is α with |α| ≤ 1 and α(τ) = 1. (IMC) is the exact frozen type of the accepted Submission.cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub, the conjunction of: (a) locality of approximate tangent spaces: for U ⊆ ℝ^P open and Borel M ⊆ M' ⊆ U with Hⁿ(M' ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M and every subspace Q, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q; (b) restriction: for U open, an IMRep R in U and a Borel set E there are a current A ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and an IMRep R' with R'.Represents A, R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E, R'.mult = R.mult, R'.orient = R.orient; (c) A − B is integer multiplicity if A, B are (U open); (d) for every IMRep R, for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ R.carrier and every n-covector α, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α. Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let R be an IMRep in U = ℝ^P (univ) of dimension n, with carrier M, multiplicity θ and orientation ξ, such that R.measure(ℝ^P) = ∫_M θ dHⁿ < ∞. Then there are, for i ∈ ℕ, maps G_i : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P, sets A_i ⊆ ℝⁿ, functions w_i : ℝⁿ → ℤ and c_i : ℝⁿ → ℝ such that: each G_i is Lipschitz; each A_i is Borel; each w_i and c_i is measurable; G_i is differentiable at every point of A_i; G_i(A_i) ⊆ M; w_i is Lebesgue integrable on A_i; for u ∈ A_i, c_i(u) ≥ 0 and |α(DG_i(u)e_0, …, DG_i(u)e_{n−1})| ≤ c_i(u)·|α| for every n-covector α (|α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α); Σ_i ∫⁻_{A_i} ofReal(|w_i|·c_i) dλ ≤ R.measure(ℝ^P); and for every continuous n-form η : ℝ^P → Λⁿ(ℝ^P) with compact support, HasSum (i ↦ ∫_{A_i} w_i(u)·η(G_i(u))(DG_i(u)e_0, …, DG_i(u)e_{n−1}) du) (R.action(η)).

B)) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α)) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), R.measure univ ≠ ∞ → ∃ (G : ℕ → Euclid n → Euclid P) (A : ℕ → Set (Euclid n)) (w : ℕ → Euclid n → ℤ) (c : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ), (∀ i, ∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L (G i)) ∧ (∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (w i)) ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (c i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ u ∈ A i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (G i) u) ∧ (∀ i, G i '' A i ⊆ R.carrier) ∧ (∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun u => (w i u : ℝ)) (A i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ u ∈ A i, 0 ≤ c i u ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |α (fun a => fderiv ℝ (G i) u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))| ≤ c i u * covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ ∑' i, ∫⁻ u in A i, ENNReal.ofReal (|(w i u : ℝ)| * c i u) ≤ R.measure univ ∧ ∀ η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, Continuous η → HasCompactSupport η → HasSum (fun i => ∫ u in A i, (w i u : ℝ) * η (G i u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ (G i) u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))) (R.action η)
